name: recursion-explorer
title: Recursion explorer
description: Runs a recursive function for real and steps through the run: the current line, the call stack, the call tree growing in call order with return values, the output, a nested expression and counters, all in sync.

classPrefix.description: Prefix of the classes on the host and generated elements.

maxSteps.description: Stop recording after this many events (a runaway recursion stays harmless).

maxDepth.description: Stop recording when calls nest deeper than this.

resetLabel.description: Button: back to the first step.

overLabel.description: Button: run the next call to completion.

outLabel.description: Button: run until the current call returns.

endLabel.description: Button: jump to the last step.

countLabel.description: Status: {k} = current step, {n} = number of steps.

exprLabel.description: Heading of the nested-expression pane (calls given a "wait" template).

treeLabel.description: Heading of the call-tree pane (click a call to jump to it).

stateLabel.description: Heading of the pane with rx.show() scenes.

maxDepthLabel.description: Counter: most calls in progress at once.

returnsOrderLabel.description: Counter: values returned so far, in order.

returnsLabel.description: Row added to a frame on the step where it returns.

treeReturn.description: Note beside a call in the tree once it has returned.

frameName.description: Name of a call's stack frame; {name} = function name, {call} = the call with its arguments.

mainName.description: Name of the driver frame (spec mainName overrides it).

ownValues.description: Preset note after the reader edits an input.

returnText.description: Step note: a return with a value.

returnVoidText.description: Step note: a return without a value.

setText.description: Step note: a local variable changes.

endText.description: Step note: the run is over.

endValueText.description: Step note: the run is over and the driver returned a value.

errorText.default: The program stopped with an error: {message}
